The '''''Warhammer''''' was a [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was active during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war, the ''Warhammer'' was [[Capture of the Warhammer|captured]] by Republic forces, and only two individuals aboard the ''Warhammer'' escaped capture, including [[Eckard Lokin]], an agent of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. The ''Warhammer''{{'s}} capture was the Republic's first confirmed sighting of Lokin, and analysis of the ''Warhammer''{{'s}} crew roster by Republic forces revealed that Lokin was not listed.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Warhammer'' and its capture were first mentioned in the Codex entry for [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Eckard Lokin in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
